title.en: Saudeleur authority: a ceremonial center on Pohnpei
title.zh: 绍德雷尔权威：波纳佩的礼仪中心

location.label: Nan Madol, Pohnpei; representative ceremonial center

summary.en:
Nan Madol’s monumental building phase offers evidence of a political order whose authority was expressed through residences, tombs and ceremony. The Saudeleur chiefs made this lagoon city a center of government and ritual. A museum synthesis describes chiefs living beside commoners and potential rivals being required to reside near the ruling center. The arrangement linked social rank to the built environment.

This political overview complements the site entry: it asks who mobilized labour and how ceremonial life helped sustain authority. Oral histories and excavated remains provide different kinds of evidence, which can be compared without treating either as an annual frontier map. The focus on buildings dated chiefly to 1200–1500 does not establish the dynasty’s exact beginning or end, or imply uniform control over every community on Pohnpei.
summary.zh:
南马都尔的大型营建阶段，为一种以住宅、墓葬和仪式体现权威的政治秩序提供了证据。绍德雷尔首领以这座潟湖城市为统治与礼仪中心。博物馆研究描述了首领与平民共同居住、潜在竞争者被要求迁近统治中心的安排，社会等级由此与建筑空间相连。

本条补充遗址介绍，关注谁动员劳力，以及礼仪生活如何维系权威。口述历史与考古遗存提供不同类型的材料，可以比较，却不能直接变成逐年疆界图。约1200—1500年的建筑分期，不等于王朝确切的起讫，也不表示波纳佩所有社区始终受到同等控制。

dateNote.en: Focus: c. 1200–1500 monumental phase, not the full dynasty’s lifespan. The point marks Nan Madol, not a surveyed territorial center.
dateNote.zh: 关注约1200—1500年的大型营建阶段，并非整个王朝寿命。点位标示南马都尔，不表示经过测绘的统治范围。

title.en: Tuʻi Tonga: authority through island connections
title.zh: 图伊汤加：岛际联系中的权威

summary.en:
A political system centered on the Tuʻi Tonga lineage integrated the Tongan archipelago while maintaining relationships with communities farther away. Archaeologists connect its consolidation after about 1200 with monumental centers, chiefly tombs, tribute and the movement of people and valuables. Chemical analysis of stone tools identifies imports from Fiji and Samoa, making exchange visible even when perishable goods have disappeared.

The evidence supports a maritime political economy, rather than a solid block of land bounded like a modern state. An imported adze establishes movement of material; it does not by itself prove annexation of the quarry’s island or a direct voyage between two points. Following Tonga alongside Samoa and Fiji reveals different combinations of craft production, kinship and authority within a connected Pacific world. The broad interval here is a qualified political focus, not a claim of unchanged government or borders.
summary.zh:
以图伊汤加谱系为中心的政治体系整合了汤加群岛，并与更远的社区保持关系。考古学家把约1200年以后的整合，与大型政治礼仪中心、首领墓葬、贡纳以及人员和贵重物品的流动相联系。石器化学分析识别出来自斐济和萨摩亚的材料，即使易腐物品已经消失，交换仍可留下证据。

这些材料支持一种海洋政治经济，不能把它画成现代国家般的连续领土。进口石锛说明材料发生移动，不能单凭它认定采石岛被兼并，或两地存在一次直航。把汤加与萨摩亚、斐济并读，可以看到工艺生产、亲属关系和权威的不同组合。本条的宽泛年代是有保留的政治关注期，不表示政府与疆界一直不变。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus c. 1200–1800 follows archaeological/dynastic studies. Influence, exchange and direct rule are different claims.
dateNote.zh: 约1200—1800年的关注期采用考古与王朝研究。影响、交换与直接统治是不同的论断。

title.en: Yap and Palau: making value across the sea
title.zh: 雅浦与帕劳：跨海创造价值

summary.en:
Yapese stone money depended on relationships that crossed the sea. Quarrying expeditions traveled to Palau, where access to suitable stone required agreements with villages holding rights to the islands. Materials, gifts and alliances were part of the process. Quarries preserve unfinished disks and working debris, connecting spectacular objects to the labour and negotiation that produced them.

Written references become visible in the eighteenth century and more frequent in the nineteenth, but documentation is not the same thing as the origin of the practice. This entry therefore uses a documentary focus window rather than inventing a founding date. The history joins Yapese valuation to Palauan land rights and maritime skill. It also explains why a coin-like object cannot be understood only by weighing its material: its social relationships and remembered history mattered alongside its physical form.
summary.zh:
雅浦石币依靠跨海关系而形成。采石队前往帕劳，必须与拥有岛屿权利的村社协商，才能开采合适石材。物品、礼物和联盟都是这一过程的一部分。采石场留下未完成的石盘与加工碎屑，把醒目的大石币同生产它们的劳动和谈判联系起来。

十八世纪已有文字记载，十九世纪的记载更加频繁；文献出现不等于习俗起源。因此，本条采用文献关注期，而不虚构创始年份。这段历史把雅浦的价值观念、帕劳的土地权利与航海技术连接起来，也说明不能只靠称量材料理解一种近似货币的物品：它承载的社会关系和被记忆的经历，同其物理形态一样重要。

title.zh: 加罗林航海：学习一片海洋

summary.en:
Carolinian navigators learn to interpret stars, waves and other environmental signs as part of an apprenticeship. Canoe building and navigation belong together: materials, asymmetrical hull design, sailing performance and knowledge of shallow water affect what a voyage can accomplish. The practice remains a living system of teaching, not merely a vanished precursor to modern instruments.

The archive assembled by Steve Thomas in the 1980 s preserves photographs, recordings and oral-history materials from Satawal and nearby islands. A later community documentary and UNESCO safeguarding recognition show continued efforts to transmit these skills. Neither the date of an archive nor the date of inscription marks the tradition’s beginning. Read beside Mau Piailug’s biography, the materials also show that knowledge moved through named teachers and relationships. They cannot authorize drawing every possible historical voyage as a documented route.
summary.zh:
加罗林航海者通过学徒训练，学习解读星辰、海浪和其他环境线索。造舟与领航相互关联：材料、不对称船体、航行性能及对浅水的认识，都影响一次航行能够达到的范围。这仍是活的教学体系，而不只是现代仪器出现前已经消失的技术。

史蒂夫·托马斯在1980年代形成的档案，保存了萨塔瓦尔及邻近岛屿的照片、录音和口述材料。后来的社区纪录片与教科文组织保护认定，呈现技能继续传承的努力。档案形成或列入名录的日期，都不是传统的起点。与毛·皮艾卢格传记并读，还能看到知识通过具体教师和关系传播；但这些材料不能让我们把所有可能的历史航行都画成已经证实的路线。

dateNote.en: Focus: 1983–1989 archival documentation through 2021 safeguarding recognition. Navigation traditions predate this interval and continue beyond it.
dateNote.zh: 关注1983—1989年的档案记录，延伸至2021年的保护认定。航海传统早于此期，也并未在此后终止。

title.en: Samoan fa‘amatai: family authority across borders
title.zh: 萨摩亚首领制度：跨境延续的家族权威

location.label: Apia; representative reference for a transnational system

summary.en:
Samoan public life is shaped by the aiga, or extended family, and matai titles through which family representatives exercise authority. A mid-twentieth-century encyclopedia described family members selecting their matai. Later scholarship shows that title-holding and obligations continued across migration, rather than remaining confined within the islands’ borders.

In New Zealand, churches and family networks provided places for community organization, while travel and remittances maintained connections with Samoa. Some overseas-born Samoans took matai titles and participated in family and village affairs. The comparison shows how an institution can change its geographic reach without becoming a different modern state. The dated sources also have limits: the older encyclopedia reflects its administrative era, while the later account concentrates on the diaspora. Neither should stand for every Samoan village or imply that one unchanging custom determines everyone’s experience.
summary.zh:
萨摩亚公共生活与aiga（扩大家族）、以及由家族代表担任的matai头衔密切相关。二十世纪中期的百科全书描述了家族成员选择首领的做法。后来的研究则表明，头衔与责任随着移民跨越国界，并没有被限制在岛屿内部。

在新西兰，教会与家族网络成为社区组织的场所；往返旅行和汇款维持同萨摩亚的联系。一些海外出生的萨摩亚人也获得头衔，参与家族和村社事务。由此可以看到，一种制度能够改变其地理范围，而不必被解释成另一个现代国家。年代不同的资料也各有限制：旧百科体现当时的行政视角，后来的文章主要讨论移民社会，不能用它们概括每个村庄，或认为一种不变习俗决定所有人的生活。

dateNote.en: Focus: independence-era 1962 through the later source’s 2022 review. This is a continuing social institution, not a bounded political state.

title.en: Madjedbebe: evidence for a deeper Australian past
title.zh: 马杰德贝贝：澳大利亚深远过去的证据

location.label: Madjedbebe, Mirarr Country; representative research location

summary.en:
Research at Madjedbebe on Mirarr Country challenges histories that begin with European arrival or with the invention of farming. A team working with Mirarr Traditional Owners published an occupation estimate of about 65,000 years in 2017. Later analyses of grinding stones examined plant processing, pigments and tool production, making everyday skill visible within the archaeological record.

The dates displayed for this entry refer to publication and research, because the occupation estimate lies beyond the atlas’s current 13,000 BCE slider limit. They must not be mistaken for the age of the site. Dating depends on stratigraphy and scientific interpretation, and the authors’ estimate should not become an unqualified date for all human arrival in Australia. The entry connects archaeology to food, technology and custodianship, while leaving different questions—such as the age of particular rock paintings—to their own evidence.
summary.zh:
米拉尔传统土地上的马杰德贝贝研究，挑战了从欧洲人抵达或农业发明才开始叙述历史的方式。与米拉尔传统所有者合作的团队，在2017年发表了约六万五千年的居住年代估计。随后对磨石的分析，考察植物加工、颜料和工具生产，使日常技能在考古记录中显现。

本条显示的年代是研究与发表时间，因为所讨论的居住年代早于地图当前公元前13000年的滑杆下限，不能把显示年份误当作遗址年龄。定年依赖地层与科学解释，作者的估计也不应变成澳大利亚所有人群抵达时间的无条件结论。本条把考古与食物、技术、传统监护关系相连；具体岩画的年代等其他问题，仍需要各自的证据。

dateNote.en: Research focus 2017–2022. Published c. 65,000-year occupation estimate lies outside the current atlas range; dates are not clamped or converted to a false civil-year start.

title.en: Baiame’s Ngunnhu: engineering, gathering and Country
title.zh: 拜亚梅鱼堰：工程、聚会与传统土地

location.label: Brewarrina fish traps, Barwon River; representative site

summary.en:
The stone fish traps at Brewarrina express knowledge of river flows and fish behaviour. Dry-stone pens and weirs guided fish into places where they could be caught while accommodating different water levels. Ngemba custodianship and shared use connected the fishery to neighbouring communities, trade, ceremonies and meetings. In the heritage account, Baiame’s creation story explains the design and responsibilities for particular traps.

This entry focuses on the 2005 National Heritage listing because the evidence inspected does not establish a secure construction year. The listing is not the beginning of the fishery, and a traditional narrative is not presented as a radiocarbon result. Comparing Brewarrina with Budj Bim reveals different Indigenous water-management systems. It also restores maintenance and collective responsibility to an engineering history that might otherwise show only stone structures without the people who understood and cared for them.
summary.zh:
布雷沃里纳石鱼堰体现了对水流与鱼类行为的认识。干砌石围栏和堰体，把鱼引入便于捕捞的位置，同时适应不同水位。恩根巴人的监护、以及同邻近社区共享使用的关系，使渔场与贸易、仪式和聚会相连。遗产说明中的拜亚梅创世故事，解释鱼堰设计及各处维护责任。

本条以2005年列入国家遗产名录为关注点，因为本次查阅的证据没有确定的建造年份。列入名录不是渔场起点，传统叙事也没有被当成放射性碳测年。与布吉必姆比较，可以认识不同的原住民水管理体系，并把维护和共同责任重新带入工程史，避免只看到石构，而看不到理解并照料它们的人。

title.en: Makasar and Yolŋu: a seasonal trade reaching China
title.zh: 望加锡与雍古：连接中国的季节贸易

location.label: Northeast Arnhem Land coast; representative exchange region

summary.en:
For at least two centuries before Australian federation, fishermen from Makassar sailed with the monsoon to the Arnhem Land coast. Trepang was caught, boiled and dried before being carried back through Asian trading networks toward Chinese markets. The work involved contact, exchange and collaboration with local Aboriginal communities, including Yolŋu people.

The encounters brought materials and technologies into northern Australian life, while words and artistic representations preserved memories of the visitors. They complicate a history that treats 1788 as the first meaningful connection between Australia and the outside world. The annual voyages were seasonal, not a claim that Makasar communities colonized Arnhem Land. Government restrictions contributed to their cessation in 1907. The source gives at least 1700 as a conventional documented starting point; earlier contact and the varied experiences of different communities require their own research rather than being assigned one common origin date.
summary.zh:
在澳大利亚联邦成立前至少两个世纪，望加锡渔民随季风航向阿纳姆地海岸。海参经过捕捞、煮制和干燥，再沿亚洲贸易网络运往中国市场。这些工作涉及与当地原住民社区的接触、交换和合作，包括雍古人。

相遇把材料与技术带入澳大利亚北部生活，语言和艺术表现也保存来访者的记忆。这使以1788年作为澳大利亚首次重要对外联系的叙述变得复杂。每年的航行是季节性的，不表示望加锡人殖民阿纳姆地。政府限制促成了1907年的终止。来源把“至少1700年”作为常用的有文献依据的起点；更早接触和各社区不同的经验，需要另行研究，不能被赋予一个共同起源日期。

dateNote.en: From at least c.1700 to 1907 follows the museum account. This concerns a trade phase, not Yolŋu cultural duration or fixed surveyed sailing routes.

title.zh: 库拉：维系伙伴关系的贵重物品

summary.en:
In the Massim region off eastern New Guinea, kula exchange connects people through the circulation of shell valuables. Red-shell necklaces and shell armbands travel through a network of partners in different directions. Decorated oceangoing canoes belong to this social world: their journeys carry obligations, reputation and relationships as well as objects.

Kula cannot be described adequately as simple barter or as the economy of a single island kingdom. A valuable may move on while the relationship between partners is renewed. Museum objects can show materials and named categories, but removing an item from circulation changes the setting in which it acquires meaning. The early-twentieth-century window here is a documentary focus associated with the period in which outsiders recorded the network; it does not date its invention or imply that the practice ended in 1922. Specific legs of a historical voyage would require separate evidence.
summary.zh:
新几内亚东部马西姆地区的库拉交换，通过贝壳贵重物品的流通把人们相连。红贝项链与贝壳臂环沿不同方向在伙伴网络中移动。装饰远洋独木舟属于同一社会世界：航行运送的不只是物品，还有责任、声望与关系。

库拉不能被充分解释成简单物物交换，或一个岛屿王国的经济。贵重物品继续流转，伙伴之间的关系则得到更新。博物馆藏品可说明材料与名称类别，但物品退出流通后，其获得意义的环境也随之改变。本条的二十世纪初年代，是外来记录形成时期的文献关注窗，不表示习俗当时才被发明，或在1922年终止。具体历史航程的每一段，仍须另有证据。

title.zh: 马拉甘：由仪式创造的记忆

location.label: Northern New Ireland; representative artistic region

summary.en:
Malagan carvings from northern New Ireland belong to ceremonies concerned with the dead, remembrance and social relationships. Their intricate forms cannot be understood only as permanent sculptures. They were made within events involving people, performance and the transfer or affirmation of responsibilities, while the carving itself might later leave the community.

A museum example dated to the late nineteenth or early twentieth century provides a material anchor for this entry. Its wood, paint and fibre preserve the work of makers, but its collection history does not preserve every meaning understood by participants. Comparing an object record with an account of ceremonial use helps distinguish an artwork’s manufacture from the wider life of a tradition. The approximate display window translates a museum dating convention; it does not assert that malagan began in 1875 or that New Ireland cultural life ended in 1925.
summary.zh:
新爱尔兰北部的马拉甘雕刻，属于与逝者、记忆和社会关系有关的仪式。复杂形态不能只被理解成永久雕塑。它们产生于包含人群、表演，以及责任转移或确认的活动中；雕刻本身后来可能离开社区。

一件被博物馆定为十九世纪末至二十世纪初的藏品，为本条提供物质参照。木、颜料和纤维保存制作者的劳动，但收藏史不能保存参与者理解的全部意义。把藏品档案与仪式使用的解释并读，有助于区分作品制作和传统更广阔的生命。本条的近似年代，是对博物馆定年惯例的转写，不表示马拉甘始于1875年，或新爱尔兰文化生活终于1925年。

title.en: Girmit in Fiji: contracts, labour and new communities
title.zh: 斐济契约劳工：合同、劳动与新社区

summary.en:
Between 1879 and 1916, Indian migrants traveled to Fiji under an indenture system serving the colonial plantation economy. The surviving emigration passes register names, ages, family connections and places of origin. Each adult, child and infant received a separate document. These records let historians reconstruct individual journeys within a system often remembered only through totals.

Sugar production, recruitment and colonial land arrangements shaped opportunities after arrival. The plantation economy depended on labour whose contracts operated within unequal relations of power, while migrants and their descendants formed communities that outlasted indenture. Reading administrative passes alongside scholarship on Fiji’s social divisions reveals both the reach and limitations of the archive. A pass documents how an administration classified a person; it cannot recover that person’s whole account of departure, work, family life or resistance. The end of recruitment was not the end of Indo-Fijian history.
summary.zh:
1879至1916年间，印度移民通过服务殖民种植园经济的契约制度前往斐济。留存的移民证记录姓名、年龄、家属关系与原籍。每个成年人、儿童和婴儿都有独立证件，使历史学家能够在常被总数掩盖的制度中重建个人经历。

制糖生产、招募和殖民土地安排，影响抵达后的机会。种植园依靠在不平等权力关系下运作的劳动合同，移民及其后代则形成了超越契约制度存续的社区。把行政证件与斐济社会分化研究并读，既能认识档案的作用，也能看到局限：证件记录行政机关如何分类一个人，不能恢复其离乡、劳动、家庭或抵抗的全部叙述。招募结束并不等于印度裔斐济人历史结束。

title.en: South Sea Islanders in Queensland: labour and coercion
title.zh: 昆士兰南海岛民：劳动与强制

location.label: Mackay sugar-growing region; representative labour location

summary.en:
Queensland’s cotton and sugar industries drew workers from many Pacific islands after 1863. Recruitment ranged from agreements entered under unequal conditions to deception and kidnapping, often called blackbirding. Men, women and children worked in plantation and other labour-intensive industries, facing dangerous conditions and limited protection. Their work linked Australian commodity production to island communities across the Pacific.

The federation-era Pacific Island Labourers Act and White Australia policy brought another form of coercion: large-scale deportation. People whose labour had helped build plantation wealth were denied secure membership in the society around them. Some remained, and their descendants maintain distinct Australian South Sea Islander identities. Collections developed with those communities combine historical photographs with contemporary testimony. Numerical totals in different accounts may count contracts or journeys rather than unique individuals; the human consequences are better understood by following both the labour system and the families who survived it.
summary.zh:
1863年以后，昆士兰棉花与甘蔗产业从许多太平洋岛屿招募劳动者。招募既有在不平等条件下达成的协议，也包括欺骗和绑架，后者常称blackbirding。男女和儿童在种植园及其他劳动密集行业工作，面临危险条件与有限保护。他们的劳动把澳大利亚商品生产同太平洋岛屿社区联系起来。

联邦时代的《太平洋岛民劳工法》与白澳政策，又带来大规模遣返这一强制形式。帮助创造种植园财富的人，被拒绝给予稳定的社会成员地位。一些人留下，其后代维持独特的澳大利亚南海岛民认同。与社区合作形成的馆藏，把历史照片与当代证言相结合。不同记载的数字可能统计合同或航次，而非独立个人；同时追踪制度与幸存家庭，更能理解其后果。

title.en: Kokoda 1942: war sustained by Papuan labour
title.zh: 1942年科科达：由巴布亚劳力支撑的战争

summary.en:
The 1942 Kokoda campaign was fought over a mountain route between Papua’s north coast and the approaches to Port Moresby. Japanese and Australian forces struggled with terrain, illness and long supply lines. Papuan soldiers and carriers were indispensable: food, ammunition and wounded people moved along paths that vehicles could not use.

Later Australian remembrance often cast the carriers as uniformly willing and selfless helpers. Research preserved by the Australian War Memorial complicates that image with evidence of conscription, poor conditions, illness and unresolved questions of compensation and recognition. Papuan experiences included service and solidarity, but also coercion and loss. Putting labour beside military operations changes the campaign’s geography: villages, carrying routes and medical evacuation become part of the story, rather than a background to battles between foreign armies. It also prevents gratitude expressed later from substituting for an account of what wartime workers experienced.
summary.zh:
1942年的科科达战役，围绕巴布亚北海岸通向莫尔兹比港外围的山地路线展开。日军与澳军都面临地形、疾病和漫长补给线的困难。巴布亚士兵与搬运工不可或缺：食物、弹药和伤员必须通过车辆无法行驶的小径运输。

澳大利亚后来的记忆常把搬运工描绘成一致自愿、无私的帮助者。澳大利亚战争纪念馆保存的研究，则以征发、恶劣条件、疾病，以及补偿和承认问题，使这一形象复杂化。巴布亚人的经验既有服务与团结，也有强制和损失。把劳动与军事行动并列，会改变战役的地理图景：村庄、运输路线和医疗撤离成为主体，不再只是外国军队作战的背景，也避免用后来的感谢取代对劳动者亲历的说明。

title.en: Guadalcanal: an island transformed by world war
title.zh: 瓜达尔卡纳尔：被世界大战改变的岛屿

summary.en:
American forces landed on Guadalcanal in August 1942, beginning a prolonged struggle with Japanese forces over an airfield and the surrounding sea approaches. Land fighting, naval engagements and aircraft operations were interdependent. Supplying troops across contested waters became as important as taking a position on land, while illness and shortages increased the cost of the campaign.

Guadalcanal also belonged to an inhabited Solomon Islands world. Coastwatching and local knowledge connected island communities to Allied intelligence, and the campaign must be read alongside the wider war in Papua and New Guinea. Official military histories explain operational decisions but tend to organize the narrative around armies and commanders. Their perspective should be supplemented by local experiences of displacement, labour and loss. The 1942–1943 interval identifies the campaign, not the start of island history or the end of the war’s consequences for Solomon Islanders.
summary.zh:
美军在1942年8月登陆瓜达尔卡纳尔，围绕机场与周边海上通道同日军展开持久争夺。陆战、海战与空中行动相互依存；穿越争夺中的海域补给部队，与夺取陆上阵地同样重要，疾病和物资短缺增加了战役代价。

瓜岛也属于有人居住的所罗门群岛世界。海岸观察与地方知识，把岛屿社区同盟军情报活动相连；战役还应与巴布亚及新几内亚的战争并读。官方军史解释作战决策，却通常围绕军队与指挥官组织叙事，需要以当地人的迁离、劳动和损失经验补充。1942—1943年标示战役，不是岛屿历史起点，也不是战争影响对所罗门群岛人结束的时间。

title.en: Yirrkala 1963: petitioning through text and Country
title.zh: 1963年伊尔卡拉：以文字与传统土地请愿

summary.en:
Yolŋu people at Yirrkala sent bark petitions to Australian parliamentarians in 1963 after land in the Arnhem Land reserve was excised for bauxite mining. The petitions joined written requests with painted designs, presenting political argument through forms connected to Country. They sought a hearing before decisions transformed the land on which people’s livelihoods and relationships depended.

The petitions did not immediately establish a legal title or stop mining. Their significance lies partly in the encounter between Yolŋu law and a parliamentary system that had acted without adequate consultation. They belong to a longer sequence that includes litigation, legislation and later land-rights campaigns. Archival survival is also part of the history: different petitions entered separate collections, and one was returned to Yolŋu custody in 2023. That later return does not change the 1963 date of the original political action.
summary.zh:
1963年，阿纳姆地保留区部分土地被划出用于铝土矿开采后，伊尔卡拉的雍古人向澳大利亚议员寄出树皮请愿书。请愿把文字请求与绘画设计结合，以同传统土地相连的形式提出政治论证，要求在改变土地之前听取意见；人们的生计与关系都依赖这些土地。

请愿并未立即确立法律上的土地权，也未停止采矿。其意义之一，在于雍古法律与一个未充分协商便作出决定的议会体系相遇。它属于包含诉讼、立法和后来土地权运动的更长序列。档案保存也构成历史的一部分：不同请愿书进入不同收藏，一份于2023年归还雍古人保管。这次后来的归还，不改变原始政治行动发生于1963年的日期。

title.en: Wave Hill: from wages to land
title.zh: 韦夫希尔：从工资诉求到土地诉求

summary.en:
In August 1966, Gurindji workers and their families left Wave Hill cattle station after disputes over wages and treatment. Vincent Lingiari became a central spokesperson. The following year the community moved to Daguragu, closer to places of cultural importance. The movement asserted a claim deeper than an improved employment contract: the land had been Gurindji Country before the pastoral company arrived.

The campaign depended on collective endurance and outside support as well as a recognized leader. Supplies, letters, petitions and political alliances sustained the community over years of uncertainty. In 1975, a portion of land was handed back, marked publicly by Prime Minister Gough Whitlam pouring earth into Lingiari’s hand. The image condensed a long struggle into one gesture. Following the sequence restores the workers, families and supporters whose actions made the ceremony possible, and distinguishes a particular handback from the resolution of every Indigenous land claim.
summary.zh:
1966年8月，在工资和待遇争议后，古林吉劳动者及家属离开韦夫希尔牧场，文森特·林吉亚里成为重要发言人。次年，社区迁至更接近文化重要地点的达古拉古。运动提出了比改善雇佣合同更深的诉求：牧业公司到来之前，这片土地就是古林吉人的传统土地。

运动既依赖被认可的领袖，也依赖集体坚持和外部支持。物资、书信、请愿与政治联盟，支撑社区度过多年不确定处境。1975年，部分土地被交还，总理高夫·惠特拉姆把泥土倒入林吉亚里手中，成为公开标志。这张照片把长期斗争浓缩为一个动作；追踪整个序列，才能重新看见使仪式成为可能的工人、家庭和支持者，并区分一次具体交还与所有原住民土地问题的解决。

title.en: Niue 1974: choosing self-government in free association
title.zh: 1974年纽埃：选择自由联系下的自治

summary.en:
Niue’s 1974 referendum offered a constitutional choice within a relationship with New Zealand. A majority supported self-government in free association, and the Niue Constitution Act took effect on 19 October. Niue developed its own governing institutions while its people retained New Zealand citizenship. The arrangement was different from either ordinary colonial administration or a complete severing of relationships.

The constitution needs to be read alongside the practical connections of migration, assistance and consultation. New Zealand’s contemporary account describes assistance with external affairs, defence and security when requested by Niue’s government. That wording should not be replaced by an assumption that Wellington simply governs Niue. Comparing the 1974 choice with the Cook Islands’1965 self-government helps show that Pacific decolonization followed several constitutional paths. Neither autonomy date represents the beginning of the islands’ communities, languages or rights to determine their future.
summary.zh:
纽埃1974年的公投，在与新西兰的关系中提供了一种宪制选择。多数投票者支持自由联系下的自治，《纽埃宪法法》于10月19日生效。纽埃发展自身治理机构，而居民保留新西兰公民身份。这既不同于普通殖民行政，也不同于完全切断关系。

理解宪法，还须结合移民、援助与协商等实际联系。新西兰当代说明把外交、防务和安全协助表述为应纽埃政府要求提供，不能把它替换成惠灵顿单方面统治纽埃的假设。把1974年的选择与库克群岛1965年的自治并读，可见太平洋非殖民化具有多条宪制道路。自治日期都不是岛屿社区、语言或决定自身未来权利的起点。

title.zh: 1979—1986年的密克罗尼西亚：联邦与自由联系

location.label: Pohnpei; representative island context, not a dated 1979–1986 government seat

summary.en:
The Federated States of Micronesia brought four island states into a constitutional federation in 1979. The political arrangement emerged from the former U.S.-administered Trust Territory, but Micronesian representatives stressed that sovereignty was not a gift created by a compact with another country. Distinct constitutional choices elsewhere in the former territory prevented it from becoming one uniform successor state.

The Compact of Free Association entered into force in 1986 and established a relationship combining Micronesian self-government with U.S. defence responsibilities and economic assistance. Primary testimony about subsequent negotiations shows that finance, services, migration and sovereignty remained subjects of bargaining. Those later debates should not be projected backward as the exact terms of the original compact. The interval here isolates a transition between constitutional government and the Compact’s commencement; it neither ends FSM history in 1986 nor establishes a boundary outline for every year.
summary.zh:
密克罗尼西亚联邦在1979年通过宪法，把四个岛州结合成联邦。这一政治安排产生于原由美国管理的托管地，但密克罗尼西亚代表强调，主权并不是与另一国家签订协定后才获得的礼物。原托管地其他地区作出不同宪制选择，也使它没有成为一个统一的继承国家。

《自由联系协定》在1986年生效，把密克罗尼西亚自治、美国的防务责任和经济援助结合。关于后来谈判的第一手证言显示，财政、公共服务、移民与主权仍是协商议题，不能把这些后来的争论倒推成原协定的完整条款。本条只标示宪法政府建立至协定开始生效的转变，并不表示联邦历史止于1986年，也不确立逐年的疆界。

title.zh: 1947年：殖民列强下的区域合作

summary.en:
The South Pacific Commission was established in 1947 by the six powers administering Pacific territories. Its Canberra Agreement created a regional mechanism for work on economic and social development and welfare after the Second World War. Research and technical cooperation could address problems crossing island boundaries, but the organization’s founding structure reflected colonial administration rather than equal representation of all island peoples.

That distinction matters when comparing the commission with the later South Pacific Forum, whose members were Pacific governments. The organizations did not simply replace one another: technical cooperation and political dialogue had different roles. The commission later became the Pacific Community, and its own institutional history interprets the founding through that longer development. Reading the founding agreement’s setting beside the history of decolonization shows how an organization can change its participants and political meaning while preserving some functions.
summary.zh:
1947年，管理太平洋属地的六个国家建立南太平洋委员会。《堪培拉协定》创设区域机制，在第二次世界大战后开展经济、社会发展与福祉工作。研究和技术合作能够处理跨越岛屿的问题，但创立结构体现殖民行政，而不是所有岛民的平等代表权。

把委员会同后来由太平洋政府组成的南太平洋论坛比较时，这一区别尤为重要。两者并非简单前后替代：技术合作与政治对话具有不同作用。委员会后来成为太平洋共同体，其机构史也从长期发展解释创立。把协定的时代背景与非殖民化历史并读，可以看到一个组织如何在保留部分职能的同时，改变参与者及政治意义。

title.en: 1971: Pacific governments build a political forum
title.zh: 1971年：太平洋政府建立政治论坛

summary.en:
The first South Pacific Forum met in Wellington in 1971, bringing together representatives of island governments alongside Australia and New Zealand. It offered a political setting different from the South Pacific Commission created by administering powers. The Forum’s history belongs to decolonization: island governments sought ways to discuss shared concerns in their own regional company.

The distinction was institutional rather than a claim that all members had identical size, resources or constitutional status. Cooperation could join leaders whose countries remained separated by oceans and by different relationships with former colonial powers. The Forum later became known as the Pacific Islands Forum. Read beside the Treaty of Rarotonga and the Pacific Community’s history, its founding helps explain how political dialogue and technical work developed on parallel tracks. A regional meeting is a documented event, not a new sovereign state to paint across the Pacific.
summary.zh:
1971年，首届南太平洋论坛在惠灵顿举行，岛屿政府代表与澳大利亚、新西兰共同参加。它提供的政治场所，不同于由属地管理国家创设的南太平洋委员会。论坛历史属于非殖民化进程：岛屿政府寻求在自身区域伙伴之间讨论共同关切。

这种区别属于制度层面，并不意味着所有成员拥有相同规模、资源或宪制地位。合作可以连接那些被海洋分隔、又与原殖民国家保持不同关系的领导人。论坛后来称太平洋岛国论坛。与《拉罗汤加条约》及太平洋共同体历史并读，其创立说明政治对话与技术工作如何并行发展。区域会议是有记录的事件，不是可以涂满太平洋的新主权国家。

title.en: Bastion Point: occupation, eviction and a continuing claim
title.zh: 堡垒角：占领、驱离与延续的诉求

summary.en:
Ngāti Whātua protesters occupied Bastion Point in January 1977 after the government announced a housing development on former reserve land. The occupation answered a longer history of compulsory acquisition that had reduced the community’s holdings. Buildings, gardens and collective residence made a land claim visible through everyday activity, not only through petitions or courtroom argument.

Police and army personnel removed 222 people in May 1978, ending an occupation that had lasted 506 days. Eviction was not the end of the claim. A later Waitangi Tribunal inquiry supported restitution, and land was subsequently returned or vested with Ngāti Whātua. The sequence connects the nineteenth-century loss of land to twentieth-century direct action and institutional redress. It also distinguishes three dates often collapsed in brief accounts: the start of protest, the state’s eviction and the later recognition of the underlying grievance.
summary.zh:
1977年1月，政府宣布在原保留地建设住宅后，恩加蒂法图阿抗议者占领堡垒角。这一行动回应了更长久的强制征地史，社区土地已被不断缩减。建筑、菜园与集体居住，使土地诉求通过日常活动显现，而不只存在于请愿和法庭论证中。

1978年5月，警察与军队驱离222人，结束持续506天的占领。驱离并不是诉求终结。后来怀唐伊审裁处调查支持归还，土地随后被交还或授予恩加蒂法图阿。整个序列把十九世纪失地、二十世纪直接行动和制度补救连接起来，也区分简述中常被混同的三个时间：抗议开始、国家驱离，以及后来承认其根本不满的过程。

dateNote.zh: 关注1977年1月至1978年5月的占领；1988年的归还决定属于后续背景，不被安排到1978年。

title.en: Moruroa and Fangataufa: nuclear testing and its aftermath
title.zh: 穆鲁罗阿与方加陶法：核试验及其后果

summary.en:
France conducted atmospheric and underground nuclear tests at Moruroa and Fangataufa in French Polynesia between 1966 and 1996. The program transformed Pacific atolls into sites of a global weapons project. Its history joins military decisions to the experiences of workers, nearby communities and people seeking information about exposure and environmental change.

The last test occurred in January 1996, but the end of explosions did not end disputes about evidence, monitoring or responsibility. An IAEA assessment examined residual radiological conditions, with a prospective scope that must be distinguished from a complete reconstruction of historical doses. Later research combined declassified monitoring material with interviews and spatial evidence. Reading these different sources together helps separate what a technical assessment measured from what affected communities asked to know. This entry does not infer an individual illness or declare every health question resolved from one report.
summary.zh:
1966至1996年，法国在法属波利尼西亚的穆鲁罗阿与方加陶法进行大气层和地下核试验，把太平洋环礁变成全球武器计划的场所。其历史把军事决策与工人、邻近社区，以及寻求辐射暴露和环境变化信息的人们联系起来。

最后一次试验发生于1996年1月，但爆炸结束并未结束关于证据、监测和责任的争议。国际原子能机构评估的是残余辐射状况，其前瞻性范围不能等同对历史剂量的完整复原。后来的研究将解密监测材料、访谈与空间证据结合。并读不同来源，有助于区分技术评估测量了什么，以及受影响社区希望知道什么。本条不据一份报告推断个人疾病成因，也不宣布全部健康问题已经解决。

title.en: 1878: Kanak resistance and the seizure of land
title.zh: 1878年：卡纳克抵抗与土地侵占

location.label: La Foa region, Grande Terre; representative uprising area

summary.en:
The 1878 Kanak uprising in New Caledonia grew within a colonial transformation of land. French settlement and control displaced communities whose farming, social ties and authority were grounded in particular places. Museum interpretations connect yam cultivation and attachment to land with the violence of dispossession. Ataï became one of the leaders associated with resistance.

The revolt and its repression were not a simple contest between two internally uniform sides. Communities made different choices under pressure, and colonial records organized people through categories serving administrative power. French newspaper accounts preserved in an archival collection show how metropolitan readers were encouraged to view the suppression of the revolt. Those accounts are evidence of colonial framing, rather than a substitute for Kanak perspectives. Relating land, food and political authority gives the event a social history alongside its military dimensions, without reducing later Kanak aspirations to one nineteenth-century episode.
summary.zh:
新喀里多尼亚1878年的卡纳克起义，发生在殖民土地关系剧变之中。法国定居与控制使社区被迫失地，而这些社区的耕作、社会联系和权威都植根具体地方。博物馆解释把山药种植、对土地的依附与剥夺的暴力相连，阿塔伊成为与抵抗相关的重要领袖之一。

起义和镇压并不是内部完全一致的两方简单对抗。各社区在压力下作出不同选择，殖民记录又按服务行政权力的类别组织人群。档案收藏中的法国报纸，显示本土读者如何被引导理解镇压；它们是殖民框架的证据，而不能代替卡纳克人的观点。把土地、食物与政治权威相连，可以在军事叙述之外恢复社会史，也避免把后来的卡纳克诉求压缩为十九世纪的一次事件。

title.en: Australia since 1901: a federation with contested inclusion
title.zh: 1901年以来的澳大利亚：联邦与成员资格之争

summary.en:
Federation in 1901 created the Commonwealth of Australia from six colonies that became states. A federal constitution distributed powers between the new Commonwealth and the states and established a parliament, executive and judiciary. The founding did not erase the states or complete the gradual development of legislative independence from Britain.

The constitutional story also concerns who could participate and on what terms. Early federal legislation entrenched racial restrictions, while later campaigns challenged exclusions affecting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and migrants. Reading the political overview beside the 1967 referendum, Wave Hill and Mabo keeps legal institutions connected to social struggles. A continuing federal polity can undergo changes in representation and rights without being replaced by a newly founded country after every reform. The 1901 start identifies the federation’s constitutional origin; it does not date the beginning of Australian Indigenous histories or justify projecting current borders into earlier centuries.
summary.zh:
1901年的联邦成立，把六个转为州的殖民地组成澳大利亚联邦。联邦宪法划分新联邦与各州的权力，并建立议会、行政和司法机构。成立联邦没有取消各州，也没有完成从英国逐步取得立法独立的全部过程。

宪制史也涉及谁能够参与、以什么条件参与。早期联邦立法确立种族限制，后来的运动则挑战针对澳大利亚原住民、托雷斯海峡岛民和移民的排斥。与1967年公投、韦夫希尔和马博案并读，可以把法律机构与社会斗争相连。一个延续中的联邦政体，能够改变代表权和权利，而不必在每次改革后被视为新国家。1901年起点标示联邦的宪制起源，不是原住民历史开端，也不允许把今日疆界倒推至更早世纪。

title.en: New Zealand since 1947: constitutional autonomy and Treaty claims
title.zh: 1947年以来的新西兰：宪制自主与条约诉求

summary.en:
New Zealand’s adoption of the Statute of Westminster in 1947 was one stage in a longer constitutional evolution. It affirmed legislative autonomy within an existing parliamentary system rather than creating the country, Māori communities or the Treaty of Waitangi from nothing. The Constitution Act 1986, effective in 1987, removed residual British legislative power and restated central arrangements for government.

The political system remains a constitutional monarchy, with Parliament, ministers and a Governor-General operating within a framework that is not contained in a single exhaustive constitutional text. Its history intersects with Māori claims about land, authority and obligations under the Treaty. Reading this overview with Waitangi, the New Zealand Wars, Whina Cooper and Bastion Point gives continuity without treating constitutional milestones as a resolution of all grievances. The chosen 1947 start is a declared constitutional phase, not the only possible answer to the question of when New Zealand became independent.
summary.zh:
新西兰在1947年采纳《威斯敏斯特法令》，是更长宪制演变中的一个阶段。它在既有议会体系内确认立法自主，而不是凭空创造国家、毛利社区或《怀唐伊条约》。1986年《宪法法》于1987年生效，移除英国残余立法权，并重述政府的主要制度安排。

这一政体仍为君主立宪制，议会、部长与总督在并非由单一完整宪法文本穷尽的框架内运作。其历史与毛利人关于土地、权威和条约义务的诉求交织。与怀唐伊、新西兰战争、菲娜·库珀及堡垒角并读，可以呈现延续性，而不把宪制里程碑当成全部不满已经解决。选择1947年为起点，是明确声明的宪制阶段，不是新西兰何时独立这一问题的唯一答案。

title.en: Whina Cooper · Housing, welfare and the land march
title.zh: 菲娜·库珀 · 住房、福祉与土地长征

summary.en:
Whina Cooper’s leadership joined practical work for Māori families with public protest over land. Elected the first president of the Māori Women’s Welfare League in 1951, she helped build a national network and promoted investigation of crowded and unhealthy housing in Auckland. Education, employment and discrimination were part of the organization’s agenda, connecting women’s collective activity to government decisions.

In 1975 she led the land march from Te Hāpua to Parliament, presenting opposition to further alienation of Māori land before a national audience. Her biography was not a simple story of unanimous support: the league and the march both involved differences over leadership and tactics. Those disagreements make collective organization visible behind an iconic individual. The focus on 1951–1975 connects urban migration, family welfare and land rights, showing that Māori political history includes the institutions of everyday care as well as major confrontations with the state.
summary.zh:
菲娜·库珀把改善毛利家庭生活的实际工作，与土地问题的公共抗议相连。1951年，她当选毛利妇女福利联盟首任主席，协助建立全国网络，并推动调查奥克兰拥挤、卫生条件不足的住房。教育、就业与歧视同属组织议程，把妇女集体行动同政府决策联系起来。

1975年，她率领从特哈普阿到议会的土地长征，使反对毛利土地进一步流失的诉求进入全国视野。她的经历不是一致支持的简单故事：联盟与长征内部都存在关于领导和策略的分歧。这些分歧使偶像人物背后的集体组织可见。1951—1975年的关注期，把城市移民、家庭福祉与土地权相连，说明毛利政治史也包含日常照料机构，而不只有同国家的大规模对抗。

title.en: Te Puea Hērangi · Rebuilding community after dispossession
title.zh: 特普埃阿·赫朗吉 · 失地后的社区重建

summary.en:
Te Puea Hērangi helped rebuild the Kīngitanga’s strength among Waikato people after invasion and land confiscation. During the First World War she supported men resisting conscription, connecting their refusal with memories of a government that had dispossessed their communities. The 1918 influenza epidemic brought further losses, and she organized care for orphaned children and surviving families.

At Tūrangawaewae she turned reconstruction into collective work: purchasing and preparing land, raising funds through performance, and building spaces for visitors and political life. Farming and land-development schemes sought an economic base for those institutions. Her work makes housing, health, food and cultural practice part of political history. It also shows why authority cannot be represented solely through the dates of kings. She exercised influence beside successive Kīngitanga leaders, while negotiations with officials and disagreements with the Crown remained part of the community’s continuing effort to recover strength.
summary.zh:
特普埃阿·赫朗吉协助怀卡托人在入侵与土地没收之后，重建毛利王运动的力量。第一次世界大战期间，她支持抵制征兵的人，把拒绝服役与政府曾剥夺社区土地的记忆相连。1918年流感造成进一步损失，她组织照顾孤儿和幸存家庭。

在图朗阿瓦埃，她把重建化为集体劳动：购买、整理土地，通过表演筹款，并营造接待来访者及开展政治生活的空间。农耕与土地开发计划，则为这些机构寻求经济基础。她的工作使住房、健康、食物与文化实践成为政治史的一部分，也说明权威不能只由君王起讫代表。她在历任王运动领袖身旁发挥影响；与官员谈判及同王室分歧，仍属于社区持续恢复力量的努力。

title.en: Faith Bandler · Organizing for constitutional change
title.zh: 费思·班德勒 · 为宪制改革组织行动

summary.en:
Faith Bandler connected a family history of Pacific labour coercion with campaigns against racial discrimination in Australia. Her father had been taken from Vanuatu to Queensland as a child. During the Second World War, Bandler worked in the Women’s Land Army; later she brought public speaking and organizational work to movements supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander rights.

Campaigning for the 1967 referendum involved meetings, fundraising, coordination and persuading voters, not only the final day of voting. Bandler helped make constitutional questions part of a wider public conversation about exclusion. The referendum changed Commonwealth legislative power concerning Aboriginal people and removed their exclusion from the constitutional population reckoning; it did not itself grant citizenship or the vote. Reading her biography beside plantation labour and the referendum shows how personal memory, alliance and sustained collective effort can change institutions without reducing reform to a single leader or a single ballot.
summary.zh:
费思·班德勒把家族经历的太平洋劳工强制，与澳大利亚反种族歧视运动相连。她父亲童年时被从瓦努阿图带至昆士兰。第二次世界大战期间，她在妇女陆军劳动队工作；后来把演讲与组织能力用于支持澳大利亚原住民及托雷斯海峡岛民权利的运动。

1967年公投运动包含会议、筹款、协调与说服选民，而不只是投票当天。班德勒使宪法问题进入关于排斥的公共讨论。公投改变联邦针对原住民的立法权限，并取消宪法人口计算中的排除条款；它本身并未授予公民身份或投票权。与种植园劳工和公投并读，可见个人记忆、联盟与持久集体努力如何改变制度，而不把改革压缩成单一领袖或一次投票。

title.en: Oodgeroo Noonuccal · Poetry, education and rights
title.zh: 乌杰鲁·努努卡尔 · 诗歌、教育与权利

location.label: Minjerribah/North Stradbroke Island; representative cultural location

summary.en:
Oodgeroo Noonuccal, also known earlier as Kath Walker, made poetry part of public argument about Aboriginal experience and rights. The publication of We Are Going in 1964 gave a named writer’s voice a place in literary institutions that had often treated Aboriginal people as subjects described by others. Her work joined writing to activism and later educational activity.

The biography also connects to archives of travel and cultural exchange. A State Library account records Walker traveling with Margaret Lawrie in the Torres Strait, reminding readers that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander histories are related but distinct. Education and environmental concern extended her work beyond a single book. Reading the poems’ publication beside her broader career avoids treating literary recognition as the end of political exclusion, or assuming that one author could speak for every First Nations community. No verse is reproduced here; readers can follow the bibliographic sources to the works themselves.
summary.zh:
乌杰鲁·努努卡尔早先也以凯思·沃克之名为人所知。她使诗歌成为讨论原住民经验与权利的公共论证。1964年《我们正在离去》的出版，使一位有姓名作者的声音进入文学机构；这些机构此前常把原住民当成由别人描述的对象。她把写作与行动结合，后来又开展教育工作。

传记也与旅行和文化交流档案相连。州立图书馆资料记录她与玛格丽特·劳里在托雷斯海峡旅行，提醒读者：澳大利亚原住民与托雷斯海峡岛民历史有关联，却并不相同。教育和环境关切使她的工作超出一本书。把出版与更广事业并读，可避免把文学承认当成政治排斥结束，或认为一位作者能够代表所有第一民族社区。本条不转载诗句，读者可循书目阅读原作。

title.en: Grace Mera Molisa · Poetry and women’s public authority
title.zh: 格蕾丝·梅拉·莫利萨 · 诗歌与妇女公共权威

summary.en:
Grace Mera Molisa’s public career crossed teaching, administration and literature during Vanuatu’s transition to independence. In a first-person account she recalled becoming headteacher of a coeducational boarding primary school in 1970. Her later poems examined a postcolonial society in which ending foreign rule did not automatically end inequalities within the new nation.

Literary scholar Selina Tusitala Marsh reads black stone as both a material feature of Vanuatu’s volcanic land and a political image in Molisa’s writing. The poetry joined attachment to vanua with criticism of the uses of authority, including relations between men and women. This was argument from within a changing society, not a claim that Indigenous identity and women’s equality were inherently opposed. Reading a personal recollection beside literary scholarship separates an author’s account of her work from later interpretation, while showing why cultural production belongs alongside the dates of independence and constitutional office.
summary.zh:
在瓦努阿图走向独立的时代，格蕾丝·梅拉·莫利萨的公共事业跨越教学、行政与文学。她在第一人称回忆中说，自己于1970年担任男女同校寄宿小学的校长。后来的诗歌审视一种后殖民社会：外国统治结束，并不自动终结新国家内部的不平等。

文学学者塞利娜·图西塔拉·马什，把“黑石”既读作瓦努阿图火山土地的物质特征，也读作莫利萨写作中的政治意象。诗歌把对vanua（土地与共同体）的依附，同对权威运用、包括男女关系的批评结合。这是变化社会内部的论辩，不是声称原住民认同与妇女平等必然对立。把个人回忆与文学研究并读，可区分作者自述和后来的解释，也说明文化生产应与独立及官职年代并列。

title.zh: 莉莉乌奥卡拉尼 · 主权、写作与歌曲

location.label: Honolulu; representative royal and political reference

summary.en:
Liliʻuokalani became Hawaiʻi’s reigning queen in 1891 and sought to strengthen the authority of the monarchy and her people. The overthrow of 1893 did not end her political activity. She opposed annexation through petitions, delegations and writing, while her supporters pursued different strategies to restore the kingdom. In 1895 she was imprisoned after an attempted restoration by some supporters.

Her 1898 autobiography offered her own account of the political crisis and challenged representations produced by opponents. Music was another form of cultural and political expression. In 1909 she established a trust for Hawaiian children, connecting her later life to care and education as well as sovereignty. Reading her own institutional legacy beside sourced historical scholarship avoids treating her only as the passive last figure in a monarchy’s fall. It also distinguishes a reigning queen from a royal consort and recognizes that political action continued after the loss of formal office.
summary.zh:
莉莉乌奥卡拉尼于1891年成为夏威夷执政女王，寻求增强君主制及其人民的权威。1893年的政变没有结束她的政治活动。她通过请愿、代表团与写作反对兼并，而支持者则以不同策略谋求恢复王国。1895年，部分支持者尝试复辟后，她被囚禁。

1898年的自传提供她本人对政治危机的叙述，挑战对手形成的形象。音乐也是文化与政治表达的方式。1909年，她为夏威夷儿童建立信托，使晚年生活同时连接主权、照料与教育。把其机构遗产与有来源的历史研究并读，可避免只把她当成王朝覆亡中被动的最后人物，也区分执政女王与王后，并认识正式官位丧失之后政治行动仍在继续。

title.en: Vincent Lingiari · Speaking for land and labour
title.zh: 文森特·林吉亚里 · 为土地与劳动发声

summary.en:
Vincent Lingiari became a spokesperson for Gurindji workers and families who left Wave Hill station in 1966. Wage discrimination and working conditions prompted the walk-off, but the demand developed into a claim to land. Moving to Daguragu in 1967 placed the community near places with meaning beyond the pastoral station’s boundaries.

His leadership worked through relationships with other elders, families, unionists and supporters who sustained the campaign. The 1975 handback ceremony made him an internationally recognized symbol, yet the handful of earth did not stand for every land question being settled. A portion of land had been returned after years of organizing. Following the sequence gives the photograph a history: a worker refused inadequate wages, a community asserted an enduring connection to Country, and political alliances helped alter what a government would recognize. The personal biography therefore complements the event record without replacing collective agency with a solitary hero.
summary.zh:
文森特·林吉亚里成为1966年离开韦夫希尔牧场的古林吉工人及家属的发言人。工资歧视与工作条件促成离场行动，诉求随后发展为土地权。1967年迁至达古拉古，使社区接近那些意义超越牧场边界的地点。

他的领导通过与其他长老、家庭、工会人士及支持者的关系发挥作用，众人共同支撑运动。1975年交还土地的仪式，使他成为国际知名象征，但一把泥土并不表示全部土地问题已经解决：多年组织之后，归还的只是一部分。追踪序列才能给照片补上历史：劳动者拒绝不足的工资，社区申明与传统土地的持久联系，政治联盟则改变政府愿意承认的范围。因此，个人传记补充事件记录，却不以孤立英雄取代集体行动。

title.en: Mau Piailug · Teaching a route through the ocean
title.zh: 毛·皮艾卢格 · 传授穿越海洋之路

location.label: Satawal; representative home and teaching reference

summary.en:
Mau Piailug, a navigator from Satawal, guided Hōkūleʻa from Hawaiʻi to Tahiti in 1976 using a system of environmental observation developed in Micronesian teaching traditions. His contribution was not simply the solution to one canoe’s navigation problem. By sharing knowledge with the Polynesian Voyaging Society, he helped establish relationships through which a younger generation could learn and practice wayfinding.

He returned to train Nainoa Thompson before the 1980 voyage and later recognized new navigators through the Pwo ceremony in 2007. Participant histories and the Satawal materials preserved in a university archive offer different windows on that work. The story links Micronesian expertise with Hawaiian cultural renewal without collapsing the two into one tradition. It also shows why historical reconstruction requires people who hold and transmit knowledge: a canoe’s successful voyage demonstrates a practiced capability, not the exact itinerary of every ancient Pacific navigator.
summary.zh:
萨塔瓦尔航海家毛·皮艾卢格于1976年引导霍库莱阿号从夏威夷驶向塔希提，运用在密克罗尼西亚教学传统中发展的环境观察体系。他的贡献不只是解决一艘独木舟的领航问题。通过与波利尼西亚航海协会分享知识，他帮助建立使新一代能够学习、实践寻路技术的关系。

1980年航行之前，他返回训练奈诺阿·汤普森，并于2007年通过Pwo仪式认可新航海者。参与者叙述与大学档案保存的萨塔瓦尔材料，为这项工作提供不同视角。故事把密克罗尼西亚专业知识与夏威夷文化复兴相连，却不把两者混为同一传统，也说明历史复原为何需要持有并传授知识的人：成功航行证明一种实践能力，不等于每位古代太平洋航海者的确切行程。

title.en: Michael Somare · Negotiating a national government
title.zh: 迈克尔·索马雷 · 协商建立国家政府

summary.en:
Michael Somare led a coalition government as Papua New Guinea moved toward self-government and independence. The transition required political negotiation within a territory containing many communities and distinct regional interests. In 1973 self-government expanded local responsibility, and in 1975 parliamentary decisions established an independence date. Somare became the first prime minister of the independent country.

This biography focuses on negotiation rather than treating independence as an automatic gift or an act achieved by one person. Coalition building, constitutional planning and the choices of other representatives mattered alongside Somare’s leadership. The Autonomous Bougainville Government’s later retrospective recalls a distinct set of concerns about regional political status within the same transition. Reading those concerns beside a national biography shows that building a state did not eliminate questions about how power should be shared. The 1972–1975 focus therefore connects a named leader to institutions and competing aspirations, while leaving later administrations and controversies to separately dated histories.
summary.zh:
巴布亚新几内亚走向自治与独立时，迈克尔·索马雷领导联合政府。这一转变需要在包含许多社区、并有不同区域利益的领土内开展政治协商。1973年的自治扩大当地责任，1975年的议会决策确立独立日期，索马雷成为独立国家首任总理。

本传聚焦谈判，而不把独立当成自动赠予，或由一人完成的行动。联合政府建设、宪法规划与其他代表的选择，同索马雷的领导一样重要。布干维尔自治政府后来的回顾，保留了同一转变中关于区域政治地位的不同关切。把这些关切与国家领袖传记并读，可以看到建国并未消除如何分配权力的问题。因此，1972—1975年的关注期，把具体人物与制度、不同愿望相连，而将后来的执政和争议留给另行定年的历史。

title.en: Epeli Hauʻofa · Reimagining a sea of connections
title.zh: 埃佩利·豪奥法 · 重新理解联系之海

location.label: University of the South Pacific, Suva; representative creative center

summary.en:
Epeli Hauʻofa challenged accounts that treated Pacific islands as isolated, small and defined mainly by dependence. His essays, fiction and poetry explored a region made through movement, relationships and creative capacity. The sea could be understood as a field of connections rather than only an obstacle separating pieces of land. This was a political and cultural argument about how people describe their own world.

At the University of the South Pacific he founded the Oceania Centre for Arts and Culture in 1997, creating a place for artists and performers as well as academic discussion. The 2008 collection We Are the Ocean brought several kinds of writing together. Institutional remembrance emphasizes his mentorship and the center’s shared creative spaces. Those accounts are evidence of his influence, not proof that every Oceanian community accepted one interpretation. His work offers readers a question for the atlas: what becomes visible when routes, relationships and cultural work receive attention alongside states and borders?
summary.zh:
埃佩利·豪奥法挑战了把太平洋岛屿描述成孤立、狭小、主要由依赖关系定义的叙述。他的散文、小说与诗歌，探索由流动、关系和创造能力形成的区域。海洋可以被理解为联系的场域，而不只是分隔陆地的障碍。这是一种关于人们如何描述自身世界的政治与文化论证。

1997年，他在南太平洋大学创立大洋洲艺术与文化中心，为艺术家、表演者和学术讨论提供场所。2008年文集《我们就是海洋》汇集多种写作。机构纪念强调其指导工作和中心共享的创作空间；这些叙述证明影响，却不证明所有大洋洲社区都接受单一解释。他的作品向地图读者提出问题：当路线、关系和文化工作与国家、边界同样受到关注时，什么会变得可见？
